decision_record: D24, 2026-11-04 (researcher): Geo-ER Pittsburgh OSM-Foursquare replaces DBLP-ACM as dataset 2; official splits; raw values with light cleanup; A = OSM, B = Foursquare; plus a computed distance_m pair field seen by teacher and student alike; macro-F1 threshold rule (D14).

source.paper: Balsebre, Yao, Cong & Hai, Geospatial Entity Resolution, WWW 2022, doi:10.1145/3485447.3512026
source.license: no licence file in the repository at this commit; records came from the OpenStreetMap (ODbL) and Foursquare APIs, and Foursquare's terms are restrictive

pair_file_format.record: COL <field> VAL <value> repeated for the fields in attribute_order

identity.line_numbering: 1-based line number in the official split file

pair_features.distance_m: great-circle (haversine) distance between record A and record B coordinates, Earth radius 6371008.8 m, rounded to whole metres; <missing> if either side lacks numeric coordinates
